  hue-preserving darkening, and a bounded exact-token fallback. The bounded
  correction engine now repairs flat focus/hover text as a foreground color,
  scoped to the control that owns the state.

  detection, hero-copy coverage evidence, and a large-bordered-card finding.
  `run-creative-bakeoff.mjs` now records `heroCopyAreaRatio`,

- Starting success rate from `npm run report:generation-success`: overall
  4/100 (4%); pack 1/2 (50%); other renderers 3/98 (3.1%).
- Intent: a failed full attempt with no own preview (`deliveryStatus: none`)
  resolves the latest other full attempt for the exact issue whose execution
  succeeded and delivery reached `preview_ready` or `published`, and links the
  issue-scoped verified preview. The UI labels it as another attempt and never
  as this attempt's own preview. Focused profiles, cross-issue success, stale
  outcomes, unsafe URLs, the focused pipeline preview host or an existing own
  client link suppress the fallback.
- Source rule: a run with delivery `none` never recorded a preview URL, because
  the workflow records the URL in the same completion payload that records
  delivery. The URL is read from the trusted `issue:<number>` generation record
  with its `issue_number` equality checked, so it cannot be another issue's
  preview. No historical backfill or new ingestion field is used.
- Implemented: shared token-free client-site URL validator in
  `src/lib/preview-proxy-contract.mjs`; `RelatedIssuePreview` on
  `AttemptDetail`; ledger resolution in `worker/src/generation-ledger.ts`;
  latest-delivered lookup in `worker/src/generation-attempts.ts`; guarded UI
  helper `relatedPreviewLink` in `src/admin/format.ts`; a clearly labeled,
  accessible section in `AttemptInspector` with a related-attempt control.
- Layout gate repair: the inspector sheet body used an implicit `auto` grid
  track, so long inspector content forced the mobile sheet to 455px inside a
  352px dialog. Constrained the inspector sheet and body tracks with
  `minmax(0, 1fr)` and `min-width: 0`, and stacked the related controls. This
